items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Each change is a one-line guard such as `if not self.field.is_cached(rel_obj):` using the existing field-cache API. Formatting matches the surrounding code. No comment explains the guard, but the intent is obvious and the nearby comment still applies.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Small guards that reuse the existing `is_cached` helper instead of adding new bookkeeping. The same guard appears in three related `get_prefetch_queryset` methods, which is consistent rather than harmful duplication. No dead code; the scratch files were deleted.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: No exception handling or magic constants involved. The guard only skips overwriting a cache entry that a nested prefetch already filled, and the reverse cache is still set otherwise. Hidden tests pass: P2P 85/85.

items.name: Guard is conditional and covers the one-to-one variant
items.name_zh: 仅在已缓存时跳过回填，并考虑一对一情形
items.evidence: Guarded the reverse-FK path (`if not self.field.is_cached(rel_obj): setattr(...)`) and `ReverseOneToOneDescriptor` (`if not self.related.field.is_cached(rel_obj)`). Assignment still happens when nothing is cached. The added test covers both the FK and one-to-one variants.
